items.prompt: Bar 1 shows three quarters. Shade bar 2 so it shows more than bar 1.
hints: Three quarters is the same as 6 eighths.
Bar 2 must show more than 6 eighths.
items.explanation: Three quarters is 6 eighths, so 7 or 8 eighths is more.

items.prompt: Bar 1 shows two fifths. Shade bar 2 so it shows more than bar 1.
hints: Two fifths is the same as 4 tenths.
Bar 2 must show more than 4 tenths.
Shade 5 or more parts of bar 2.
items.explanation: Two fifths is 4 tenths, so anything above 4 tenths is more.
